SERVICE CONTRACT OF EMPLOYMENT

Effective Date: 22 February 2026
Employer: Summit Healthcare Solutions Inc.
Employee: Emily Watson

This document sets forth the terms under which Summit Healthcare Solutions Inc. agrees to employ Emily Watson.

Role & Responsibilities
The Employee is hired for the position of Research Scientist. The Employee will be expected to perform all duties associated with this role competently and professionally.

Work Location
The primary workplace is Level 18, 123 Pitt Street, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia. Remote working arrangements may be agreed upon separately.

Employment Period
Start Date: 22 February 2026
End Date: 22 February 2029

The first 2 months of employment shall be a probationary period during which either party may terminate the employment with one week's notice.

Compensation
The Employee will receive C$92,000 per annum annual, paid on the 15th of each calendar month. An annual performance bonus of up to 10% of the annual salary may be awarded at the Company's discretion.

Notice & Termination
Either party may end this agreement with two weeks written notice. Immediate termination is permitted where the Employee is guilty of gross misconduct, fraud, or a serious breach of company policy. Payment in lieu of notice may be made at the Employer's discretion.

Penalties for Breach
Should the Employee terminate employment without proper notice, a deduction equivalent to a penalty not exceeding 25% of the total annual remuneration will be made from any outstanding amounts owed to the Employee.

Disputes
All disputes relating to this Agreement shall be resolved through the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC). Legal costs shall be borne by each party respectively unless otherwise ordered.

Governing Law: the Commonwealth of Australia

Signatures:

_______________                    _______________
Summit Healthcare Solutions Inc.                     Emily Watson
Date: 22 February 2026            Date: 22 February 2026

Employer: Oakmont Advisory Group (hereinafter referred to as "the Company")
Employee: Andrew Ross (hereinafter referred to as "the Employee")

1. POSITION AND DUTIES

The Company hereby employs the Employee in the role of UX Designer. The Employee shall perform all duties customarily associated with this position and such other duties as may be reasonably assigned.

2. PLACE OF WORK

The Employee's principal place of work shall be 9 Battery Road, Straits Trading Building, Singapore 049910. The Company reserves the right to require the Employee to work at other locations as reasonably necessary.

This Agreement shall commence on 2026-09-20 and shall continue until 2027-09-20, unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions herein. The first 1 month of employment shall be a probationary period during which either party may terminate the employment with one week's notice.

4. REMUNERATION

The Employee shall receive a annual gross salary of $62,500 (USD) per annum, payable in arrears on the 30th of the following month.

Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing 60 days written notice to the other party. The Company may terminate the Employee's employment immediately for cause, including but not limited to gross misconduct, material breach of duty, or fraud. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC). The decision of the arbitration body shall be final and binding on both parties.

CONSULTANCY AND EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

PARTICULARS OF EMPLOYMENT

Employee Name: George White
Employer Name: Crimson Bay Media Ltd.
Job Title: Account Manager
Date of Commencement: 14th December 2026
Contract End Date: 14th December 2029
Place of Work: 1 George Street, Level 10, Singapore 049145

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

1. Job Description
You are employed by Crimson Bay Media Ltd. in the capacity of Account Manager. Your role is a full-time position and you will be expected to devote your full working time and attention to the duties of your role.

2. Probationary Period
There will be an initial probationary period of 1 month. During this time, the Employee's performance and suitability will be assessed.

3. Hours of Work
Your normal working hours are 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break. You may be required to work additional hours as necessary for the proper performance of your duties.

4. Remuneration
Your annual salary is £63,000 annually. Salary is paid on the 30th of each calendar month by bank transfer. 

5. Holiday Entitlement
You are entitled to 30 days paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

6. Sick Pay
Statutory sick pay will be provided in accordance with applicable legislation. The Company may, at its discretion, provide enhanced sick pay.

7. Pension
The Company operates a contributory pension scheme and you will be automatically enrolled in accordance with auto-enrolment legislation.

8. Termination
This employment may be terminated by either party giving 30 days written notice. The Company may terminate your employment without notice for gross misconduct. The Employer may place the Employee on garden leave during the notice period.

9. Post-Termination Restrictions
In the event of a material breach by the Employee, including but not limited to early resignation without serving the required notice period, the Employee shall pay the Employer liquidated damages equal to the equivalent of the remaining contract value.

10. Grievance and Dispute Resolution
Any workplace grievance should be raised with your line manager in the first instance. If unresolved, disputes shall be submitted to the courts of England and Wales. The decision of the arbitration body shall be final and binding on both parties.

11. Data Protection
The Company will process your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. A separate privacy notice will be provided to you.

12. Governing Law
This contract is governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore.

ACCEPTANCE

I, George White, confirm that I have read, understood, and agree to the terms set out above.

Employee Signature: _________________________  Date: _________________________

Employer Signature: _________________________  Date: _________________________
Crimson Bay Media Ltd.

EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

This EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 18th November 2025 by and between:

Employer: Oakmont Advisory Group (hereinafter referred to as "the Company")
Employee: Victoria Hughes (hereinafter referred to as "the Employee")

1. POSITION AND DUTIES

The Company hereby employs the Employee in the role of Account Manager. The Employee shall perform all duties customarily associated with this position and such other duties as may be reasonably assigned.

2. PLACE OF WORK

The Employee's principal place of work shall be 401 Park Avenue South, 10th Floor, New York, NY 10016, USA. The Company reserves the right to require the Employee to work at other locations as reasonably necessary.

3. TERM OF EMPLOYMENT

This Agreement shall commence on 18th November 2025 and shall continue until 18th November 2026, unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions herein. There will be an initial probationary period of 90 days. During this time, the Employee's performance and suitability will be assessed.

4. REMUNERATION

The Employee shall receive a annual gross salary of GBP 84,500 p.a., payable on or before the 20th of each month. 

5. TERMINATION

Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing 14 days written notice to the other party. The Company may terminate the Employee's employment immediately for cause, including but not limited to gross misconduct, material breach of duty, or fraud. Upon termination, the Employee must return all company property within 7 days.

6. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS AND BREACH

If the Employee breaches any material term of this Agreement, the Employee shall be liable to pay the Employer compensation of three months' salary as liquidated damages. This is without prejudice to the Employer's right to claim additional damages.

7. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by the courts of the State of New York. 

8. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Province of Ontario, Canada.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

Oakmont Advisory Group                     Victoria Hughes

LETTER OF APPOINTMENT

THIS LETTER OF APPOINTMENT is made on 2025-02-01

BETWEEN:

(1) Global Nexus Enterprises Ltd., a company incorporated and registered under the laws of Ireland (the "Employer"); and

(2) Ava Mitchell (the "Employee").

IT IS AGREED as follows:

CLAUSE 1 - APPOINTMENT

1.1 The Employer appoints the Employee and the Employee agrees to serve the Employer as Business Development Executive with effect from 2025-02-01.

1.2 The Employee shall carry out such duties and exercise such powers as are from time to time assigned to or vested in the Employee by the Board of Directors.

CLAUSE 2 - WORKPLACE

2.1 The Employee's normal place of work shall be at Level 5, 600 Bourke Street, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia, or at such other place within reasonable commuting distance as the Employer may from time to time require.

CLAUSE 3 - DURATION

3.1 The employment under this Agreement shall begin on 2025-02-01 and shall continue until 2027-02-01 unless terminated earlier in accordance with Clause 6 below.

3.2 Probationary Period: 3 months. During the probation period, either party may terminate the employment with 7 days' written notice.

CLAUSE 4 - COMPENSATION

4.1 The Employer shall pay the Employee a annual salary of €57,500 (EUR) per year.

4.2 Payment shall be made in arrears on the 28th of the following month by direct bank transfer to the Employee's nominated bank account. 

CLAUSE 5 - CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 The Employee shall not, during the course of employment or at any time after its termination, disclose or make use of any confidential information belonging to the Employer without prior written consent.

CLAUSE 6 - TERMINATION

6.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving not less than 30 days prior written notice.

6.2 The Employer may summarily dismiss the Employee without notice or payment in lieu of notice if the Employee commits any act of gross misconduct, is convicted of a criminal offence, or is in material breach of any term of this Agreement. Upon termination, the Employee must return all company property within 7 days.

CLAUSE 7 - BREACH OF CONTRACT

7.1 Should the Employee terminate employment without proper notice, a deduction equivalent to three months' salary will be made from any outstanding amounts owed to the Employee.

CLAUSE 8 - DISPUTE RESOLUTION

8.1 Any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to the London Court of International Arbitration (LCIA). Both parties agree to attempt mediation before commencing formal proceedings.

CLAUSE 9 - GOVERNING LAW

9.1 This Agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Ireland.

SIGNED by the parties on the date first written above.

_________________________          _________________________
For Global Nexus Enterprises Ltd.                 Ava Mitchell

SERVICE CONTRACT OF EMPLOYMENT

THIS SERVICE CONTRACT OF EMPLOYMENT is made on October 2, 2024

BETWEEN:

(1) Echo Valley Software Inc., a company incorporated and registered under the laws of the Province of Ontario, Canada (the "Employer"); and

(2) Michelle Edwards (the "Employee").

IT IS AGREED as follows:

CLAUSE 1 - APPOINTMENT

1.1 The Employer appoints the Employee and the Employee agrees to serve the Employer as Senior Software Developer with effect from October 2, 2024.

1.2 The Employee shall carry out such duties and exercise such powers as are from time to time assigned to or vested in the Employee by the Board of Directors.

CLAUSE 2 - WORKPLACE

2.1 The Employee's normal place of work shall be at Level 18, 123 Pitt Street, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia, or at such other place within reasonable commuting distance as the Employer may from time to time require.

CLAUSE 3 - DURATION

3.1 The employment under this Agreement shall begin on October 2, 2024 and shall continue until October 2, 2026 unless terminated earlier in accordance with Clause 6 below.

3.2 There will be an initial probationary period of 6 months. During this time, the Employee's performance and suitability will be assessed.

CLAUSE 4 - COMPENSATION

4.1 The Employer shall pay the Employee a monthly salary of C$3,000 (CAD) per month.

4.2 Payment shall be made on or before the last day of each month by direct bank transfer to the Employee's nominated bank account. An annual performance bonus of up to 20% of the annual salary may be awarded at the Company's discretion.

CLAUSE 5 - CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 The Employee shall not, during the course of employment or at any time after its termination, disclose or make use of any confidential information belonging to the Employer without prior written consent.

CLAUSE 6 - TERMINATION

6.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving not less than 30 days prior written notice.

6.2 The Employer may summarily dismiss the Employee without notice or payment in lieu of notice if the Employee commits any act of gross misconduct, is convicted of a criminal offence, or is in material breach of any term of this Agreement. Payment in lieu of notice may be made at the Employer's discretion.

CLAUSE 7 - BREACH OF CONTRACT

7.1 The Employee acknowledges that a breach of the non-compete or confidentiality provisions may result in a penalty of 50% of the annual salary. The Employee further agrees not to solicit or engage with any of the Employer's clients for a period of 12 months following termination.

CLAUSE 8 - DISPUTE RESOLUTION

8.1 Any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC). 

CLAUSE 9 - GOVERNING LAW

9.1 This Agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Province of Ontario, Canada.

SIGNED by the parties on the date first written above.

_________________________          _________________________
For Echo Valley Software Inc.                 Michelle Edwards

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

1. Job Description
You are employed by Crestview Software Solutions in the capacity of Compliance Officer. Your role is a full-time position and you will be expected to devote your full working time and attention to the duties of your role.

2. Probationary Period
There will be an initial probationary period of 4 months. During this time, the Employee's performance and suitability will be assessed.

Your normal working hours are 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break. You may be required to work additional hours as necessary for the proper performance of your duties.

Statutory sick pay will be provided in accordance with applicable legislation. The Company may, at its discretion, provide enhanced sick pay.

This employment may be terminated by either party giving 30 days written notice. The Company may terminate your employment without notice for gross misconduct. The Employer may place the Employee on garden leave during the notice period.

In the event of a material breach by the Employee, including but not limited to early resignation without serving the required notice period, the Employee shall pay the Employer liquidated damages equal to a sum equal to twice the monthly salary.

Any workplace grievance should be raised with your line manager in the first instance. If unresolved, disputes shall be submitted to the courts of the State of New York. Both parties agree to attempt mediation before commencing formal proceedings.

The Company will process your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. A separate privacy notice will be provided to you.

This contract is governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Australia.

ACCEPTANCE

GRADUATE EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

THIS GRADUATE EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT is made on 20 May 2024

BETWEEN:

(1) Quantum Wave Technologies, a company incorporated and registered under the laws of the Republic of Singapore (the "Employer"); and

(2) Thomas Reed (the "Employee").

IT IS AGREED as follows:

CLAUSE 1 - APPOINTMENT

1.1 The Employer appoints the Employee and the Employee agrees to serve the Employer as Business Development Executive with effect from 20 May 2024.

1.2 The Employee shall carry out such duties and exercise such powers as are from time to time assigned to or vested in the Employee by the Board of Directors.

CLAUSE 2 - WORKPLACE

2.1 The Employee's normal place of work shall be at 401 Park Avenue South, 10th Floor, New York, NY 10016, USA, or at such other place within reasonable commuting distance as the Employer may from time to time require.

CLAUSE 3 - DURATION

3.1 The employment under this Agreement shall begin on 20 May 2024 and shall continue until 20 May 2025 unless terminated earlier in accordance with Clause 6 below.

3.2 The Employee shall be subject to a probation period of 2 months from the commencement date. The Company reserves the right to extend the probation period by a further 2 months if necessary.

CLAUSE 4 - COMPENSATION

4.1 The Employer shall pay the Employee a annual salary of $111,500 (USD) annually.

4.2 Payment shall be made on the 30th of each calendar month by direct bank transfer to the Employee's nominated bank account. 

CLAUSE 5 - CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 The Employee shall not, during the course of employment or at any time after its termination, disclose or make use of any confidential information belonging to the Employer without prior written consent.

CLAUSE 6 - TERMINATION

6.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving not less than three months prior written notice.

6.2 The Employer may summarily dismiss the Employee without notice or payment in lieu of notice if the Employee commits any act of gross misconduct, is convicted of a criminal offence, or is in material breach of any term of this Agreement. Upon termination, the Employee must return all company property within 7 days.

CLAUSE 7 - BREACH OF CONTRACT

7.1 In the event of a material breach by the Employee, including but not limited to early resignation without serving the required notice period, the Employee shall pay the Employer liquidated damages equal to six months' salary.

CLAUSE 8 - DISPUTE RESOLUTION

8.1 Any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to the courts of England and Wales. The decision of the arbitration body shall be final and binding on both parties.

CLAUSE 9 - GOVERNING LAW

9.1 This Agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Singapore.

SIGNED by the parties on the date first written above.

_________________________          _________________________
For Quantum Wave Technologies                 Thomas Reed

The Company hereby employs the Employee in the role of Compliance Officer. The Employee shall perform all duties customarily associated with this position and such other duties as may be reasonably assigned.

The Employee's principal place of work shall be 20 Fenchurch Street, Level 15, London EC3M 3BY, United Kingdom. The Company reserves the right to require the Employee to work at other locations as reasonably necessary.

4. REMUNERATION

The Employee shall receive a annual gross salary of C$91,500 per annum, payable on the 10th of each calendar month.

Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing four weeks written notice to the other party. The Company may terminate the Employee's employment immediately for cause, including but not limited to gross misconduct, material breach of duty, or fraud. Payment in lieu of notice may be made at the Employer's discretion.

Your monthly salary is £10,500 per month. Salary is paid in arrears on the last business day of the following month by bank transfer. An annual performance bonus of up to 25% of the annual salary may be awarded at the Company's discretion.

6. Sick Pay
Statutory sick pay will be provided in accordance with applicable legislation. The Company may, at its discretion, provide enhanced sick pay.

This employment may be terminated by either party giving one week written notice. The Company may terminate your employment without notice for gross misconduct.

Employee: Victoria Hughes (hereinafter referred to as "the Employee")

1. POSITION AND DUTIES

2. PLACE OF WORK

The Employee's principal place of work shall be Suite 800, 333 Seymour Street, Vancouver, BC V6B 5A6, Canada. The Company reserves the right to require the Employee to work at other locations as reasonably necessary.

3. TERM OF EMPLOYMENT

This Agreement shall commence on 11th May 2024 and shall continue until 11th May 2027, unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions herein. Probationary Period: 4 months. During the probation period, either party may terminate the employment with 7 days' written notice.

4. REMUNERATION

The Employee shall receive a monthly gross salary of €5,500 (EUR) per month, payable monthly on the 5th of each month. 

5. TERMINATION

Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing three months written notice to the other party. The Company may terminate the Employee's employment immediately for cause, including but not limited to gross misconduct, material breach of duty, or fraud. 6. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS AND BREACH

Should the Employee terminate employment without proper notice, a deduction equivalent to 50% of the annual salary will be made from any outstanding amounts owed to the Employee.

Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by the Employment Tribunal of England and Wales. 

8. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

THIS INTERNSHIP AGREEMENT is made on 12th July 2024

BETWEEN:

(1) Horizon Digital Services Pte. Ltd., a company incorporated and registered under the laws of the State of California (the "Employer"); and

(2) Zoe Collins (the "Employee").

IT IS AGREED as follows:

CLAUSE 1 - APPOINTMENT

1.1 The Employer appoints the Employee and the Employee agrees to serve the Employer as Senior Consultant with effect from 12th July 2024.

1.2 The Employee shall carry out such duties and exercise such powers as are from time to time assigned to or vested in the Employee by the Board of Directors.

CLAUSE 2 - WORKPLACE

2.1 The Employee's normal place of work shall be at 200 Bay Street, Suite 3600, Toronto, ON M5J 2J5, Canada, or at such other place within reasonable commuting distance as the Employer may from time to time require.

CLAUSE 3 - DURATION

3.1 The employment under this Agreement shall begin on 12th July 2024 and shall continue until 12th July 2025 unless terminated earlier in accordance with Clause 6 below.

3.2 The first 3 months of employment shall be a probationary period during which either party may terminate the employment with one week's notice.

CLAUSE 4 - COMPENSATION

4.1 The Employer shall pay the Employee a monthly salary of AUD 8,000 monthly.

4.2 Payment shall be made on the 25th of each calendar month by direct bank transfer to the Employee's nominated bank account. An annual performance bonus of up to 20% of the annual salary may be awarded at the Company's discretion.

CLAUSE 5 - CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 The Employee shall not, during the course of employment or at any time after its termination, disclose or make use of any confidential information belonging to the Employer without prior written consent.

CLAUSE 6 - TERMINATION

6.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving not less than two months prior written notice.

6.2 The Employer may summarily dismiss the Employee without notice or payment in lieu of notice if the Employee commits any act of gross misconduct, is convicted of a criminal offence, or is in material breach of any term of this Agreement. Payment in lieu of notice may be made at the Employer's discretion.

CLAUSE 7 - BREACH OF CONTRACT

7.1 Should the Employee terminate employment without proper notice, a deduction equivalent to three months' salary will be made from any outstanding amounts owed to the Employee.

CLAUSE 8 - DISPUTE RESOLUTION

8.1 Any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to the courts of the State of California. Legal costs shall be borne by each party respectively unless otherwise ordered.

CLAUSE 9 - GOVERNING LAW

9.1 This Agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.

SIGNED by the parties on the date first written above.

_________________________          _________________________
For Horizon Digital Services Pte. Ltd.                 Zoe Collins

LETTER OF APPOINTMENT

THIS LETTER OF APPOINTMENT is made on 4th March 2025

BETWEEN:

(1) Granite Peak Construction, a company incorporated and registered under the laws of the Province of Ontario, Canada (the "Employer"); and

(2) Patrick O'Brien (the "Employee").

IT IS AGREED as follows:

CLAUSE 1 - APPOINTMENT

1.1 The Employer appoints the Employee and the Employee agrees to serve the Employer as Compliance Officer with effect from 4th March 2025.

1.2 The Employee shall carry out such duties and exercise such powers as are from time to time assigned to or vested in the Employee by the Board of Directors.

CLAUSE 2 - WORKPLACE

2.1 The Employee's normal place of work shall be at Level 12, 60 Margaret Street, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia, or at such other place within reasonable commuting distance as the Employer may from time to time require.

CLAUSE 3 - DURATION

3.1 The employment under this Agreement shall begin on 4th March 2025 and shall continue until 4th March 2027 unless terminated earlier in accordance with Clause 6 below.

3.2 Probationary Period: 6 months. During the probation period, either party may terminate the employment with 7 days' written notice.

CLAUSE 4 - COMPENSATION

4.1 The Employer shall pay the Employee a annual salary of £40,500 per year.

4.2 Payment shall be made on the last business day of each calendar month by direct bank transfer to the Employee's nominated bank account. The Employee may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, subject to company and individual performance.

CLAUSE 5 - CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 The Employee shall not, during the course of employment or at any time after its termination, disclose or make use of any confidential information belonging to the Employer without prior written consent.

CLAUSE 6 - TERMINATION

6.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving not less than three months prior written notice.

6.2 The Employer may summarily dismiss the Employee without notice or payment in lieu of notice if the Employee commits any act of gross misconduct, is convicted of a criminal offence, or is in material breach of any term of this Agreement. Upon termination, the Employee must return all company property within 7 days.

CLAUSE 7 - BREACH OF CONTRACT

7.1 Should the Employee terminate employment without proper notice, a deduction equivalent to six months' salary will be made from any outstanding amounts owed to the Employee.

CLAUSE 8 - DISPUTE RESOLUTION

8.1 Any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to the American Arbitration Association (AAA). The arbitration shall be conducted in English.

CLAUSE 9 - GOVERNING LAW

9.1 This Agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Province of Ontario, Canada.

SIGNED by the parties on the date first written above.

_________________________          _________________________
For Granite Peak Construction                 Patrick O'Brien

Effective Date: 2025-02-08
Employer: Oakmont Advisory Group
Employee: Claire Bennett

This document sets forth the terms under which Oakmont Advisory Group agrees to employ Claire Bennett.

Role & Responsibilities
The Employee is hired for the position of Digital Marketing Specialist. The Employee will be expected to perform all duties associated with this role competently and professionally.

Work Location
The primary workplace is Level 25, 385 Bourke Street, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia. Remote working arrangements may be agreed upon separately.

Employment Period
Start Date: 2025-02-08
End Date: 2027-02-08

Probationary Period: 1 month. During the probation period, either party may terminate the employment with 7 days' written notice.

Compensation
The Employee will receive C$88,000 (CAD) per year annual, paid monthly on the last day of each month. An annual performance bonus of up to 25% of the annual salary may be awarded at the Company's discretion.

Notice & Termination
Either party may end this agreement with three months written notice. Immediate termination is permitted where the Employee is guilty of gross misconduct, fraud, or a serious breach of company policy. 

Penalties for Breach
In the event of a material breach by the Employee, including but not limited to early resignation without serving the required notice period, the Employee shall pay the Employer liquidated damages equal to a penalty not exceeding 25% of the total annual remuneration.

Disputes
All disputes relating to this Agreement shall be resolved through the courts of the State of California. The decision of the arbitration body shall be final and binding on both parties.

Governing Law: England and Wales

Signatures:

_______________                    _______________
Oakmont Advisory Group                     Claire Bennett
Date: 2025-02-08            Date: 2025-02-08

EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

This EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 3rd March 2026 by and between:

Employer: Redwood Capital Management (hereinafter referred to as "the Company")
Employee: Victoria Hughes (hereinafter referred to as "the Employee")

1. POSITION AND DUTIES

The Company hereby employs the Employee in the role of Compliance Officer. The Employee shall perform all duties customarily associated with this position and such other duties as may be reasonably assigned.

2. PLACE OF WORK

The Employee's principal place of work shall be One Canada Square, Canary Wharf, London E14 5AB, United Kingdom. The Company reserves the right to require the Employee to work at other locations as reasonably necessary.

3. TERM OF EMPLOYMENT

This Agreement shall commence on 3rd March 2026 and shall continue until 3rd March 2028, unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions herein. Probationary Period: 90 days. During the probation period, either party may terminate the employment with 7 days' written notice.

4. REMUNERATION

The Employee shall receive a monthly gross salary of €4,700 (EUR) per month, payable in arrears on the 15th of the following month. An annual performance bonus of up to 10% of the annual salary may be awarded at the Company's discretion.

5. TERMINATION

Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing four weeks written notice to the other party. The Company may terminate the Employee's employment immediately for cause, including but not limited to gross misconduct, material breach of duty, or fraud. The Employer may place the Employee on garden leave during the notice period.

6. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS AND BREACH

Should the Employee terminate employment without proper notice, a deduction equivalent to the equivalent of the remaining contract value will be made from any outstanding amounts owed to the Employee.

7. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre (HKIAC). 

8. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Singapore.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

_________________________          _________________________
Redwood Capital Management                     Victoria Hughes
(Employer)                         (Employee)

EMPLOYMENT AND SERVICE AGREEMENT

THIS EMPLOYMENT AND SERVICE AGREEMENT is made on 27th May 2025

BETWEEN:

(1) Cedar Point Retail Group, a company incorporated and registered under the laws of the Province of Ontario, Canada (the "Employer"); and

(2) Natalie Ward (the "Employee").

IT IS AGREED as follows:

CLAUSE 1 - APPOINTMENT

1.1 The Employer appoints the Employee and the Employee agrees to serve the Employer as Chief Technology Officer with effect from 27th May 2025.

1.2 The Employee shall carry out such duties and exercise such powers as are from time to time assigned to or vested in the Employee by the Board of Directors.

CLAUSE 2 - WORKPLACE

2.1 The Employee's normal place of work shall be at Level 5, 600 Bourke Street, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia, or at such other place within reasonable commuting distance as the Employer may from time to time require.

CLAUSE 3 - DURATION

3.1 The employment under this Agreement shall begin on 27th May 2025 and shall continue until 27th May 2028 unless terminated earlier in accordance with Clause 6 below.

3.2 Probationary Period: 2 months. During the probation period, either party may terminate the employment with 7 days' written notice.

CLAUSE 4 - COMPENSATION

4.1 The Employer shall pay the Employee a monthly salary of S$13,800 per calendar month.

4.2 Payment shall be made on or before the 10th of each month by direct bank transfer to the Employee's nominated bank account. The Employee may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, subject to company and individual performance.

CLAUSE 5 - CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 The Employee shall not, during the course of employment or at any time after its termination, disclose or make use of any confidential information belonging to the Employer without prior written consent.

CLAUSE 6 - TERMINATION

6.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving not less than one week prior written notice.

6.2 The Employer may summarily dismiss the Employee without notice or payment in lieu of notice if the Employee commits any act of gross misconduct, is convicted of a criminal offence, or is in material breach of any term of this Agreement. The Employer may place the Employee on garden leave during the notice period.

CLAUSE 7 - BREACH OF CONTRACT

7.1 In the event of a material breach by the Employee, including but not limited to early resignation without serving the required notice period, the Employee shall pay the Employer liquidated damages equal to a penalty not exceeding 25% of the total annual remuneration.

CLAUSE 8 - DISPUTE RESOLUTION

8.1 Any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to the Federal Court of Australia. Legal costs shall be borne by each party respectively unless otherwise ordered.

CLAUSE 9 - GOVERNING LAW

9.1 This Agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Province of Ontario, Canada.

SIGNED by the parties on the date first written above.

_________________________          _________________________
For Cedar Point Retail Group                 Natalie Ward

Date: 8th December 2024

To: James Richardson

Dear James Richardson,

We are pleased to confirm your appointment with Blue Harbour Trading Co. on the following terms and conditions:

Position: Systems Administrator

You will be employed as Systems Administrator reporting to the department head. Your duties will include all responsibilities normally associated with this role.

Location of Work:
Your normal place of work will be 3 Temasek Avenue, Centennial Tower, Level 21, Singapore 039190. You may be required to travel or work at other company premises from time to time.

Commencement and Duration:
Your employment will commence on 8th December 2024 and is expected to continue until 8th December 2026.

The Employee shall be subject to a probation period of 1 month from the commencement date. The Company reserves the right to extend the probation period by a further 1 month if necessary.

Salary:
Your monthly salary will be €5,500 (EUR) monthly, which will be paid monthly on the 20th of each month. An annual performance bonus of up to 20% of the annual salary may be awarded at the Company's discretion.

Termination of Employment:
Your employment may be terminated by either party giving 90 days notice in writing. The Company reserves the right to terminate your employment without notice in cases of serious misconduct, dishonesty, or persistent underperformance. The Employer may place the Employee on garden leave during the notice period.

Breach of Contract:
The Employee acknowledges that a breach of the non-compete or confidentiality provisions may result in a penalty of six months' salary. The Employee further agrees not to solicit or engage with any of the Employer's clients for a period of 12 months following termination.

Dispute Resolution:
In the event of any dispute arising from this employment, both parties agree to submit the matter to the courts of the State of New York. The decision of the arbitration body shall be final and binding on both parties.

Please confirm your acceptance of the above terms by signing and returning a copy of this letter.

Yours sincerely,

The Employee is hired for the position of Civil Engineer. The Employee will be expected to perform all duties associated with this role competently and professionally.

Work Location
The primary workplace is Level 18, 123 Pitt Street, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia. Remote working arrangements may be agreed upon separately.

Employment Period
Start Date: 2026-03-23
End Date: 2029-03-23

There will be an initial probationary period of 3 months. During this time, the Employee's performance and suitability will be assessed.

Compensation
The Employee will receive $101,500 annually annual, paid in arrears on the 28th of the following month. 

Notice & Termination
Either party may end this agreement with 60 days written notice. Immediate termination is permitted where the Employee is guilty of gross misconduct, fraud, or a serious breach of company policy. Payment in lieu of notice may be made at the Employer's discretion.

Penalties for Breach
The Employee acknowledges that a breach of the non-compete or confidentiality provisions may result in a penalty of 50% of the annual salary. The Employee further agrees not to solicit or engage with any of the Employer's clients for a period of 12 months following termination.

Disputes
All disputes relating to this Agreement shall be resolved through the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC). The decision of the arbitration body shall be final and binding on both parties.

Governing Law: the Republic of Singapore
